splash_screen.custom_code:
<style>
  body { margin:0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1b627a 0%, #004173 100%); height:100vh; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden; }
  .logo-wrap { width: 225px; height: 225px; }
  
        .x-rib { fill: url(#shineGrad); }
        .logo-wrap { animation: floatY 2.2s infinite ease-in-out; }
        @keyframes floatY { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-8px); } }
      
</style>
<svg class="logo-wrap" viewBox="0 0 1000 1000" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="shineGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#8ec5ff">
        <animate attributeName="offset" values="0;1;0" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <path class="x-rib rib-left" d="M 315.7 196.1 L 443.1 196.1 L 486.3 272.5 L 637.3 56.9 L 486.3 317.6 L 427.5 219.6 L 352.9 219.6 L 437.3 382.4 L 254.9 694.1 L 415.7 382.4 Z"/>
  <path class="x-rib rib-right" d="M 745.1 56.9 L 576.5 396.1 L 674.5 574.5 L 535.3 574.5 L 500.0 502.0 L 358.8 698.0 L 502.0 454.9 L 552.9 547.1 L 635.3 547.1 L 547.1 396.1 Z"/>
  
</svg>
<script>
  setTimeout(function() {
    if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.xsignSplash) {
      window.webkit.messageHandlers.xsignSplash.postMessage("finished");
    }
  }, 3200);
</script>
